Gideon, your first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**. The post said both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. I found nothing earlier in the channels you can see, so I can't say whether you reported it somewhere else before that.

The guard was **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard** while the kiosks were down. That is from your own 10:42 post. Mateo added at 10:44 that six trucks were waiting at the east gate.

- **Recovery:** Mateo posted at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. At 11:08 you posted that both lanes had been working since 11:07.
- **Gap:** The channel doesn't say when the guard stopped using the clipboard. It only shows the guard checking in trailer 8836 on kiosk 1 at 11:03.
- **Time zone:** The times above are Hartford local, which is UTC-5.
